name: Jasper
description: Bring the power of Jasper into Claude, including your brand voices, audiences, style guides, knowledge as context, product details, and agents for GEO and multi-language translation. Instead of relying on PDFs or isolated skill.md files, Jasper brings your brand, knowledge, and guardrails into Claude, so every output is on-brand and grounded in your business.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jasper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jasper to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jasper.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jasper MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jasper provides these MCP tools: generate-content, get-jasper-agents, get-jasper-audiences, get-jasper-brand-voices, get-jasper-style-guides, run-jasper-agent, and search-knowledge-base.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jasper?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jasper in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Jasper requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jasper is developed by Jasper. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
